selectionRule: SELECT id, ts_ms, from_name, to_name, body FROM messages WHERE kind = "say" AND to_name != "" ORDER BY id

excluded.why: channel test -- real request shape, but not real traffic

reviewers.note: also wrote the rubric and recorded a prediction beforehand
blind to primary labels; told not to open other audit files

blindSample.method: stratified on hard cases: multi-kind, apparent obligations, corrections, unassessable outcomes, and the four dropped obligations. NOT representative -- cannot be used for prevalence.

sourceCaveat: audit-source.json is VERBATIM STORED text, which is not always the sender intended prose. Two messages (155, 268) exist only to correct bodies the shell mangled before storage, and two rows carry known-wrong from_name (see diary 40, 41).
